additional_info.subject: Update to Plugzio Home Screen Screensaver Image -MP/R4 170001683 and MP/R5 170001840
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Helpdesk,
Good day!
As the charging point operators for the target group
JNBK Plugz Prod
, we would like to request an update to one of the images used for the screensaver —MP/R4 170001683 and MP/R5 170001840.
The charger’s home screen button is currently blocking the QR code on the image. We have attached a new design with the QR code repositioned higher to prevent this issue. Please replace the existing design with the updated version.
Kindly ensure that the settings remain unchanged and no other images are removed from the current set-up. Please inform us once the update has been completed.
Thank you.
Best Regards
